title: ConsentRecord
description: A record of explicit consent granted or withheld by a Person for a specific action or use of their information. Consent is always explicit and reversible. No automated system may act on data that lacks a valid consent record for that action type.

consent_id.description: Stable UUID for this consent record.

person_id.description: The Person who granted or withheld this consent.

opportunity_id.description: If consent is scoped to a specific appearance opportunity, its ID. Null for blanket consent.

expires_at.description: When this consent expires, if time-limited.

evidence_reference.description: Reference to the document, email, or form where consent was obtained (touchpoint_id, document URL, or signed release ID).

scope_notes.description: Any restrictions or conditions the person attached to their consent.

promotion_required.description: Guests are NEVER required to promote the show. This field must always be false; any consent record that sets it to true fails validation. The no-promotion rule is a design invariant, not a configuration option.
